about.title: THE PERSON BEHIND THE SYSTEMS
paragraphs: I'm Aaron Thomas Blessen, a software developer with a B.Tech background in Computer Science and Engineering. My work crosses AI/ML, backend systems, web experiences, and applications.
That path has taken me through RAG and LLM work at ISRO, cryptography at Intel Unnati, an award-winning research paper, and a runner-up hackathon project.
I've also helped build the coding community at CODE@Saintgits. The through line: understand the problem, build something concrete, and give other people something to build on.
